SEARCH
Module jakarta.data
Package jakarta.data.spi.expression.path

Interface Path<T,U>

Type Parameters:
T - entity type
U - type of the intermediate object that owns the navigated attribute
All Known Subinterfaces:
BooleanPath<T,U>, ComparablePath<T,U,C>, NavigablePath<T,U,V>, NumericPath<T,U,N>, TemporalPath<T,U,V>, TextPath<T,U>
public interface Path<T,U>
Supertype of all path expressions in the Jakarta Data SPI.

A path expression represents navigation from a navigable expression to one of its attributes, as produced by the navigate methods of NavigableExpression.

The two type parameters identify the ends of the navigation step:

  • T — the root entity type, carried unchanged through any number of navigation steps.
  • U — the intermediate type that owns the attribute being navigated to, i.e. the type of the expression().

Each concrete subtype additionally captures the type of the attribute that was navigated to and extends the corresponding expression interface:

  • BooleanPath — navigates to a BooleanAttribute, extending BooleanExpression.
  • ComparablePath — navigates to a ComparableAttribute, extending ComparableExpression.
  • NavigablePath — navigates to a NavigableAttribute, extending NavigableExpression so that further navigation is possible.
  • NumericPath — navigates to a NumericAttribute, extending NumericExpression.
  • TemporalPath — navigates to a TemporalAttribute, extending TemporalExpression.
  • TextPath — navigates to a TextAttribute, extending TextExpression.

This interface is part of the Jakarta Data SPI for Jakarta Data providers. Applications must not use the SPI directly and can instead obtain path expressions from the navigate methods of NavigableExpression:

  • NavigableExpression.navigate(BooleanAttribute)
  • NavigableExpression.navigate(ComparableAttribute)
  • NavigableExpression.navigate(NavigableAttribute)
  • NavigableExpression.navigate(NumericAttribute)
  • NavigableExpression.navigate(TemporalAttribute)
  • NavigableExpression.navigate(TextAttribute)

  • Method Details

    • expression

      @Nonnull NavigableExpression<T,U> expression()
      An expression representing the navigable path, up to, but not including, the attribute().

      For the first step in a path, this is a metamodel attribute of the entity. For subsequent steps, this is a NavigablePath.

      Returns:
      an expression representing the navigable path, up to, but not including, the attribute().

    • attribute

      @Nonnull Attribute<U> attribute()
      The metamodel attribute to which this path navigates. Together with expression(), this fully identifies the path step represented by this object.
      Returns:
      the attribute to which this path navigates
